description: Collage – Image-First Storytelling for Power BI Collage lets you bring images, videos, and visual context directly into your Power BI reports. Create beautiful, Instagram-style galleries that turn image data into something your audience actually wants to explore. Why use Collage? Traditional Power BI visuals focus on numbers and charts. Collage is built for when the image itself matters. Whether you’re reviewing marketing content, showcasing products, or analyzing visual data, Collage helps you tell a clearer, more engaging story. Turn image URLs into polished, interactive galleries Present photos, videos, and metadata in a clean, modern layout Make visual data actionable with filtering and bookmarks Designed for real-world use cases Marketing & social media analysis – review posts, creatives, and engagement metrics E-commerce & product teams – display product images alongside performance data Quality, inspection, and field data – review photo evidence directly in reports Executive storytelling – add visual context that charts alone can’t provide Beautiful layouts that adapt to your report Collage offers multiple presentation styles so your visuals fit naturally into your report design: Grid view for compact, high-density image galleries Detail view for immersive, feed-style storytelling Lightbox view for focused image or video review Images automatically scale, align, and…
